title: Data inventory + retention sources (working sheet) — Retention Controls v1
content:
Last updated: 2025-02-18 (Olga)

Purpose
- Working inventory of datasets in scope for Retention Controls v1 + Compliance Reporting Pack v1.
- Captures: where data lives, current retention, target defaults, enforcement method, ownership, and auditability/evidence pointers.
- NOTE: This is not a full company-wide log inventory. Some infra/vendor logs are governed by SRE standards and/or vendor maximums (see rows marked “vendor-managed”).

Legend / definitions
- “Current retention” = what we believe is deployed today (may differ by region/vendor account; validate for enterprise deals).
- “Target default” = baseline default we plan to expose/attest for v1.
- Guardrails (v1 proposal): min 7 days (most types), max 7 years (audit logs may allow 10 years for regulated Private, TBD).
- “Configurable per tenant (v1)” means: tenant admin can set via Console/API (subject to guardrails) OR Redwood support-only.
- “Legal hold” means: data is not deleted by automated retention enforcement while hold is active.

Open questions (tracked inline)
- Q1: Do we include raw prompt/response payload retention controls in v1? (Current: OUT OF SCOPE; only metadata + derived telemetry)
- Q2: For Dedicated/Private, do we support per-environment overrides (prod vs staging) in v1 or v1.1?
- Q3: Can we provide a consistent “effective policy + last enforcement run” for vendor-managed stores (Datadog/Loki)?

Next actions (owner/DRI)
